name: Warm Outreach Pipeline
subtitle: Research a list, get personalized DMs, approve every message before it queues.
summary: The full outreach chain: reads a contact list, your signal-agent leads, or a dataset you already collected, researches each person's recent posts into a brief (1 credit per person, asked first, unresearched profiles refunded), writes one DM per person in your own format quoting something they actually posted, and opens a review card where you edit or skip every message before anything queues. Results come back as counts, never names.
howToAsk: Warm up my [list] with personalized DMs
Research my leads and DM them in my style.
provide: which list, agent, dataset, or handles, your DM format or an example, batch size (10-20 works best).
get: per-person briefs, one personalized DM each, a review-and-approve card with day-by-day sending.
launchPrompt: Warm outreach: check my recent datasets and signal-agent leads, or use these handles if I have neither: [paste 5-10 handles]. Research the top 10 to 20 people, draft a personalized DM for each in the style of this example: [paste an example DM], and show me everything to review before anything is queued.
